column1: # Every individually named rule in the two XSD 1.1 Recommendations, and what
# spec  anchor  kind  name  status  site  note  fixtures
# The first four columns are generated — they are Appendix B of each REC, where
# every named rule is a `div.constraintnote` with a stable anchor. Regenerate
# The last three are a judgement about this crate, and are maintained by hand.
# `tests/spec_rules/main.rs` is the gate: it holds the row count, requires a site
# for anything claimed, requires a note for anything not, and — the join that
# matters — requires every DiagCode to be attributable to a rule here.
#   yes               enforced, at the site named
#   partial           enforced in part; the note says what is missing
#   by-construction   nothing to enforce: the rule constrains the shape of a
#                     component, and a component built by this loader cannot
# A rule's status is about *enforcement*, except for the sixteen Schema
# Information Set Contributions, which are outputs rather than constraints.
# For those, `yes` means the contribution reaches a consumer of the PSVI.
# Coverage of the specification is the point of this file, and it is not the
# same thing as coverage of the code: 88.9% of regions says nothing about a
# rule nobody wrote. The counts below are what it says instead.
